spec_doc: docs/specs/openrouter-reference.red-spec.json — OpenRouter as the reference provider for the completions seat: the one-line flip. Provider doc: docs/providers/openrouter.md. Laws: tests/openrouter_reference.test.ts (11, root band) and tests/security/openrouter_live_smoke.spec.ts (1, spends; named skip). MEASURED at origin/main 471169e: (1) selectChairInvoker builds the tier map from COLTRANE_TIER_ECONOMY/_STANDARD/_PREMIUM only, so one model named once leaves two tiers refused unresolved_tier; (2) mapUsage reads prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and DeepSeek's prompt_cache_hit/miss_tokens but not OpenRouter's documented prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens, so cache writes are priced as uncached input; (3) OpenRouter's usage.cost (documented as always included, in USD) is dropped; (4) a chair that reports tokens but no cost seals cost_usd: 0 on its record (makeUsageSink.reported returns chairCost) and folds 0 into manifest.usage.total_cost_usd with no marker. THE MODEL VARIABLE: the codebase already has a name for 'the model a chair invokes' — COLTRANE_MODEL (src/worker_env.ts; the Claude seat's fallback under its tier table via resolveModel: tier wins, then the fallback). The one-line mode reuses it with the SAME precedence rather than minting COLTRANE_COMPLETIONS_MODEL: COLTRANE_TIER_<X> wins for its tier; COLTRANE_MODEL seats every other tier; neither → unresolved_tier, nothing sent. COST DECISION (usage.cost): the engine USES a transport-reported cost. A round whose reply carries a finite, non-negative reported cost settles at that cost, even when COLTRANE_PRICES_FILE also prices the served model; the price table prices only rounds that report none; a round with neither is unpriced. Reason: usage.cost is what OpenRouter charged ('the total amount charged to your account'), MEASURED; the table is the deployment's estimate, and OpenRouter routes one model slug across upstream providers at different prices, so a flat per-model table cannot be exact where the provider's own charge is. It also means the one-line flip settles real spend with no price file at all. A reported 0 (a :free model) is a known price and settles as 0; an ABSENT cost is not 0. SHAPE THE LAWS PIN (the implementer chooses the internal carrier, e.g. ModelReply.cost_usd from the port, preferred by priceRound): manifest.usage.total_cost_usd; GigUsage.unpriced_invocations?: number (invocations that reported tokens but no cost — a new optional field in src/ledger.ts beside unattributed_invocations; when > 0, total_cost_usd is a lower bound); an unpriced chair's sealed record carries NO cost_usd. OPEN (to be settled by the live smoke, not guessed): whether OpenRouter's prompt_tokens includes cache_write_tokens as well as cached_tokens — the documented example (prompt_tokens 194, cache_write_tokens 100) implies subset, and the laws assume it; BYOK (is_byok, cost_details.upstream_inference_cost) is not modelled.
validation_criteria: every non-skipped law is red at origin/main 471169e for its own reason, or holds there and is turned red by its plant (L1c, L2b — planted, observed red, reverted)
the gig-level usage laws (L2c-L2f) seat their chair through COLTRANE_TIER_STANDARD, so they are red for the usage/cost defect and not for the missing one-line variable
no law reaches a network: the door laws stub the global fetch (the selector respects a host-installed fetch) and narrow PATH so no claude spawn can run
the fixtures are labelled 'documented example, NOT a recorded live response' with source URLs and fetch dates; nothing presents them as live

the live smoke is skipped and prints UNVERIFIED unless COLTRANE_COMPLETIONS_URL is https://openrouter.ai/... and COLTRANE_COMPLETIONS_KEY is set; run live it writes the RECORDED response, dated, over the fixture (only one that carries a cache read)
tsc --noEmit clean; the rest of the suite green; scripts/laws.sh counts bumped (root +11 laws / +1 file, security +1 file)
implementer obligation: src/worker_env.ts COLTRANE_MODEL meaning names its completions-seat role (the one-line model under the tier map)
implementer obligation: the `coltrane dispatch` CLI summary (src/cli.ts, the '$x.xx' line) says 'unpriced' when usage.unpriced_invocations > 0 rather than printing a bare total
follow-up, not in this change: `coltrane chat` (src/bus_terminal.ts) reads COLTRANE_TIER_<tier> only and should share the selector's resolution

Merge after them; the runtime edit is local to makeUsageSink/finalizeUsage.

testing_method: vitest, example-based and behavioural. The door laws drive bootstrapServerDeps + dispatchTool('gig_dispatch') — the real selection (selectChairInvoker from process.env) and resolution (makeCompletionsInvoker) path — over a stubbed global fetch that answers in OpenRouter's documented Response shape: each seat seals with an output_write tool call and closes its turn, and BOTH rounds carry the law's usage. Expected token splits and costs are computed from the fixture's own counts, so the live smoke's recorded response can replace the documented one without editing a law. L3 measures which COLTRANE_* variables the door reads through a recording Proxy env rather than listing them. L4 is the only law that reaches OpenRouter and lives in the security band (a band may reach out; the root suite may not).
